workflow.name: Public CCXT quickstart acceptance
workflow.scope: Linux release wheel and bundled CLI; public read-only 30-day 1h perpetual OHLCV; public default fees; backtest; HTML report. No credentials, private API calls, or orders.

exchange_results.notes: The uploaded summary reports 46 rejected orders, all with BUSINESS_VIOLATION for a missing verifiable reference price during minimum-notional validation. The zero-fill result is therefore an order-admission failure and does not show that EMA-cross produced no signals.

exchange_results.message: api.binance.com/api/v3/exchangeInfo returned a restricted-location eligibility response on the hosted runner

interpretation: This proves the public-data quickstart, report generation, and bundled Linux install for the tested OKX and Bitget public-data paths only.
It does not prove private authenticated requests, testnet order execution, live trading, or strategy profitability.
Binance remains unverified by this runner because its public market endpoint denied access by region; this evidence must not be used to bypass that restriction.
